name: io.github.birkskyum/maplibre-mcp
title: maplibre-mcp
description: An MCP server that lets AI agents check, render and show MapLibre styles

environmentVariables.name: MAPLIBRE_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: The toolsets to turn on, comma separated, like style,gl-js,martin. Defaults to style,gl-js, and all turns on every toolset.

environmentVariables.name: MARTIN_URL
environmentVariables.description: The Martin server that the martin toolset reads and renders with. Defaults to http://localhost:3000.
